### Bible Pathways - July 7, 2007
Author: Bible Pathways
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/biblepathways/bible-pathways-july-7-2007-11545767.html
Passage: Psalm 75:6-7
Points:
- No earthly power can prevent the Lord from protecting and blessing those who obey His Word.
- Human promotion and lasting honor do not arise from worldly directions or efforts, but from God alone.
- God sovereignly governs all human affairs, executing impartial and righteous judgment.
- Boastful and rebellious people will be brought down, while the humble righteous will ultimately be exalted.
- Believers facing distress should turn to persistent prayer, confident in God's covenant faithfulness.
